AUTHOR: Baletaud
TITLE: Automatic detection, identification and counting of deep-water snappers on underwater baited video using deep learning
REGION: New Caledonia EEZ (South Pacific): 11 seamount summits and 4 deep island slopes, 47–552 m depth
SPECIES: 11 Lutjanidae: Pristipomoides filamentosus, P. flavipinnis, P. argyrogrammicus, P. multidens, P. zonatus, Aphareus rutilans, Etelis coruscans, E. carbunculus, Aprion virescens, Parapristipomoides squamimaxillaris, Randallichthys filamentosus
DATA: Own deep-water stereo-BRUVS footage (121 deployments, 2019–2020, RV ALIS campaigns); 410 15-s clips around MaxN events; 6,364 images / 12,100 annotations
V_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'Sample depths varied between 47 and 552 m'; cameras 'at 1200 lumens, 120-degree angle led light'; Discussion: 'presence or absence of natural light' — qualitative only, no visibility-stratified results
D2: 80/20 by BRUVS deployment: 5,031 train images (9,782 annotations) / 1,333 test images (2,318 annotations)
D_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'Splitting considered individual BRUVS to avoid images of the same species and BRUVS in the training and testing dataset, and thus minimize false negatives'
R_EV: Discussion: 'our study relied on a dataset restricted to New Caledonia' — single region, held-out BRUVS split only
C_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'All images where the faster R-CNN detected deep water snappers were reviewed and manually corrected by an expert biologist. This process eliminated false positives'; Results: '1786 were true positives (76%) so 565 were false positives'
E_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'the number of automatic detections per frame (MaxNAuto) in the test dataset was compared to the number of manual annotations (MaxNMan)'; Results: 'Pearson Correlation coefficient ranged between 0.72 and 0.90'
ARCH: Faster R-CNN with Inception-ResNet V2 backbone (TensorFlow 2 model zoo), 1024x1024 input, 200,000 iterations, batch 8
METR: Per-species recall, precision, F-measure (automatic and semi-automatic); MaxNAuto/MaxNSemi vs MaxNMan Pearson r, R², linear regression slope and intercept tests
NOTE: Split by BRUVS deployment (video-level) with explicit leakage rationale (D4 = Y); D3 = Y from filtering of overlapping MaxN sequences to avoid duplicated identical images. No confidence threshold reported (C1 = NR); C5 coded as 검증 표본 오탐률 because the semi-automatic protocol has an expert review every image with detections and reports FP counts/precision (all detections, not a sample). C4 = Y assumes C4 denotes false-positive discussion. E4 = FNR via per-species recall and explicit false-negative discussion (underestimation at high abundance). MaxN comparison is against manual annotation of the same test frames/BRUVS (E5 = same-footage human reading). V2/V3 = Y assume depth and illumination fields. Stereo-BRUVS but no length measurement performed.
